name: Maxima
source: After losing a comrade, Maxima decided to discard his old life by changing his face and identity. He became a cyborg with superhuman strength and some cyberpathy. Of the two, Maxima is the more sociable one. He often handles social situations for K' and apologizes for his rude behavior. While serious about his duties, he does have a cute side. He loves sweets, and is so mellow that characters often think he's bit older than he is.
